Must all the charms of nature then
Can hell demand, can heaven condemn
The man whom Jesus deigns to love?
No line of this stanza quotes a verse closely; it is the hymn's own confession.
Watts printed the hymn under Mark 10:21. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

Jesus looked at him, loved him, and said to him, “There is one thing you lack: Go, sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.” MARK 10:21 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ MARK 10
But mark the change! thus spake the Lord, "Come, part with earth for heaven to-day," The youth astonish'd at the word, In silent sadness went his way. STANZA III
